On September 26, 1870,

A year later, on August 1, 1871,

At Katanon, Germany, on March 22, 1880,
several bright luminous objects were sighted just before dawn,

This account was published in the British Nature magazine.
In 1885, the Bermuda Royal Gazette

In 1890, aerial objects were sighted over the Dutch East Indies.

An official publication of the United States Weather Bureau, the magazine Weather Review, gave an account in a 1907 issue.
